content: We begin by evaluating the ability of the CSM component of our system to correctly generate the character space. To do so, during training, 30% of the character-HLA pairs (which are either 0 or 1) are masked, and this is used as a validation set (see Figure FIGREF9). For each character $c$, the model generates a list of the 12,815 unique HLAs ranked similarly to BIBREF29 hu2008collaborative for $c$. We look at the recall of our CSM model, which measures the percentage of total ground truth HLAs (over all characters $c$) present within the top N ranked HLAs for all $c$ by our model. That is:
